stem: A baby who searches for a toy only where it was PREVIOUSLY found, even after watching it being hidden in a NEW location, demonstrates the classic:
explanation: The A-not-B error is a sensorimotor-stage phenomenon where infants perseverate on the previous hiding location, revealing incomplete object permanence.

stem: A Class-9 student recognises the logical validity of an argument's FORM even while knowing its factual content is false (e.g. 'all birds fly, a penguin is a bird, so a penguin flies'). This demonstrates:

options.option_text: Formal operational reasoning — separating logical form from real-world content

explanation: Separating logical validity from factual truth is a hallmark of formal operational thought (11+).
